title: Louisiana Rebellion of 1768
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Louisiana Rebellion of 1768", at revision 1370627124, opens: "The Rebellion of 1768, also known as the Revolt of 1768 or the Creole Revolt, was an unsuccessful attempt by the Louisiana French Creole elite of New Orleans, along with nearby German settlers, to reverse the transfer of the French Louisiana to Spain, as had been stipulated in the 1762 Treaty of Fontainebleau." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q172313, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "unsuccessful attempt by Creole and German settlers around New Orleans, Louisiana to stop the handover of the French Louisiana Territory, as had been stipulated in the Treaty of Fontainebleau, to Spain in 1762". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
